summary.tldr: Requires recycling programs for certain electronic products that contain toxic substances before they can be made or imported for sale in Canada.
what_it_does: Adds a new list of electronic products in Schedule 7 that the Governor in Council can update if a product contains a toxic substance listed in Schedule 1.
Prohibits manufacturing or commercial import of listed electronic products unless the company has its own recycling program or joins one run by a designated organisation.
Requires recycling programs to collect waste electronics, set disposal rules, track and audit the program, and include public education or awareness efforts.
Requires manufacturers and importers to give the Minister proof within 90 days that they have set up or joined a program that meets the rules.
Lets the Governor in Council make rules on approved organisations and on how listed electronic products must be disposed of.
Allows the federal rules to not apply in a province if the province has similar laws and agrees to share information on administration and enforcement.
summary.background: The bill amends the Canadian Environmental Protection Act, 1999. It adds a new Division on control of waste electronic products and a new schedule for listed electronic products.
